Soms is dat een gesprek van 20 minuten waarin iemand beleefd afhoudt. En soms is het het moment waarop een vennoot even stil valt en zegt: dit scheelt me een halve dag per week. Welke kantoren, langs welke weg, met welke opening. Je stuurt bij zodra je merkt wat aanslaat. Je bouwt en runt de volledige pipeline zelf: eerste contact, discovery, demo, bezwaren, onderhandeling. Je staat er niet alleen voor, het Saga team denkt mee. Je vertaalt wat je in de markt hoort naar een Belgisch playbook en deelt dat met sales, marketing en product. Op events en workshops in heel het land ben jij het gezicht van Saga. Je houdt je pipeline realistisch en up-to-date in HubSpot, zodat jij en iedereen rond jou hetzelfde beeld van de markt hebben. review_candidates.description: About the role We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer with proven expertise in testing agentic systems to establish and coordinate quality assurance across the platform and all Agentic Solutions published on it. Based in Egypt, you will work with developers, engineering leads, the Proxy Product Owner and business stakeholders across the entire project. You will combine hands-on testing and automation with the development of consistent quality standards, evaluation methods and release criteria. Your scope will cover both the reliability of the underlying platform and the ability of individual Agentic Solutions to complete business tasks accurately, securely and within their authorised boundaries. Key responsibilities 1. QA strategy and practice • Define and implement a QA strategy covering functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance and AI evaluation testing. • Establish consistent testing standards across teams and workstreams. • Prioritise coverage according to business impact and risk, automating critical journeys first. • Work with developers to embed testing throughout delivery and improve the testability of new features. • Maintain a consolidated view of quality, coverage gaps and release risks. 2. platform testing • Design and execute tests for platform APIs, user interfaces, tenant provisioning, authentication, roles and permissions. • Validate knowledge-base management, agent and crew orchestration, tracing, configuration and billing capabilities. • Test integrations between platform components and external services. • Verify tenant isolation, access boundaries and correct handling of sensitive data, working with security specialists. • Test failure handling and recovery, including timeouts, retries, unavailable dependencies and interrupted workflows. • Ensure platform changes do not introduce regressions in existing capabilities or published Agentic Solutions. 3. Agentic Solution validation • Define and execute a repeatable validation process for every Agentic Solution before publication and following significant changes. • Test complete business journeys against agreed requirements and expected outcomes. • Validate tool selection, tool inputs, execution sequences, API interactions, knowledge retrieval, memory and human handoffs where applicable. • Inspect execution traces to assess intermediate actions and identify the source of failures. • Verify that agents handle ambiguous requests, missing information, unexpected inputs and dependency failures appropriately. • Confirm that agents respect authorisation boundaries, approval requirements and limits on their actions. • Test safeguards against prompt injection, sensitive-data disclosure, unauthorised actions and unintended or duplicate execution. • Use controlled test environments to validate actions without affecting live customers or production data. 4. AI evaluation and regression • Build and maintain versioned evaluation datasets covering representative business scenarios, edge cases and adversarial inputs. • Define measurable acceptance thresholds with the Proxy Product Owner and relevant business owners. • Evaluate task completion, factual accuracy, grounding, tool-use correctness and compliance with solution-specific requirements. • Combine automated scoring with human review where appropriate, accounting for variability in AI outputs. • Run regression evaluations following changes to models, prompts, tools, knowledge sources or platform components. • Maintain traceability between evaluation results and the versions of the solution, model and configuration tested. 5. Test automation and CI/CD • Build and maintain automated API, integration, browser-based and end-to-end test suites. • Integrate tests and AI evaluations into GitHub-based CI/CD workflows. • Implement agreed quality gates for pull requests, releases and solution publication. • Maintain reliable test data, fixtures and environments. • Investigate unstable tests and keep automated results actionable and trustworthy. 6. Performance and reliability • Test platform and solution behaviour under expected load and concurrent usage. • Measure latency, throughput, failure rates and recovery behaviour. • Assess response times and cost per completed agentic journey against agreed targets. • Identify bottlenecks and work with engineers to verify improvements. 7. Defect management and release readiness • Record defects in GitHub with reproducible steps, expected and actual results, severity, evidence and affected versions. • Work with the Proxy Product Owner and engineering leads to assess business impact and prioritise fixes. • Track defects through resolution, retesting and closure. • Provide evidence-based release and publication recommendations. • Document outstanding defects, untested areas and residual risks so designated release owners can make informed decisions. • Translate production incidents and recurring defects into regression tests and process improvements. 8. Reporting and collaboration • Provide a formal weekly quality update to the Global Head of Platform, Proxy Product Owner and engineering leads. • Report test results, critical defects, coverage gaps, AI evaluation trends and release readiness. • Escalate significant quality risks promptly, with their impact and recommended actions. • Participate in refinement and planning to challenge unclear requirements and improve acceptance criteria. • Present relevant findings and demonstrations during team reviews and Show & Tell sessions. Required experience and skills • At least five years of experience in software QA or test engineering, including substantial hands-on automation experience. • Demonstrated experience establishing or improving QA practices across software delivery teams. • Proven hands-on expertise testing tool-using AI agents and multi-step agentic workflows, including intermediate actions, failure recovery and business-outcome completion. • Practical experience building AI evaluation datasets, automated evaluation pipelines and regression suites. • Strong Python skills for test automation, using pytest or equivalent tooling. • Strong API testing skills and experience with browser automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress or equivalent. • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions. • Experience with performance and load testing of API-based services. • Working understanding of RAG, agent orchestration, tool calling, memory and execution tracing. • Familiarity with security and privacy testing relevant to enterprise AI systems. • SQL and data-validation skills. • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain quality risks clearly to technical and business stakeholders. • A proactive approach: you identify gaps, investigate issues independently and bring practical recommendations. Nice to have • Experience with AI evaluation tools such as promptfoo, Ragas, DeepEval or equivalent. • Experience testing enterprise platforms with multiple tenants. • Background in conversational AI, contact-centre technology or customer experience. • Experience testing voice agents, including interruptions, speech recognition, latency and human transfer. • Exposure to GCP, containerised environments and cloud-native applications. • Experience with production monitoring and AI observability. • ISTQB, ISTQB AI Testing or equivalent certification.
